DFEDTARL.label: Federal funds target lower bound
DFEDTARL.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED

DFEDTARU.label: Federal funds target upper bound
DFEDTARU.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED

DGS1MO.label: 1-month Treasury yield
DGS1MO.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS1MO.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS3MO.label: 3-month Treasury yield
DGS3MO.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS3MO.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS6MO.label: 6-month Treasury yield
DGS6MO.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS6MO.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS1.label: 1-year Treasury yield
DGS1.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS1.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS2.label: 2-year Treasury yield
DGS2.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS2.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS5.label: 5-year Treasury yield
DGS5.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS5.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS7.label: 7-year Treasury yield
DGS7.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS7.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS10.label: 10-year Treasury yield
DGS10.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS10.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS20.label: 20-year Treasury yield
DGS20.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS20.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

DGS30.label: 30-year Treasury yield
DGS30.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
DGS30.notes: Constant-maturity Treasury yield; market holidays appear as missing observations.

T10Y2Y.label: 10-year minus 2-year Treasury spread
T10Y2Y.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis using U.S. Treasury data
T10Y2Y.notes: Multiply percentage points by 100 to display basis points. Published dates may differ from DGS component series.

T10Y3M.label: 10-year minus 3-month Treasury spread
T10Y3M.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis using U.S. Treasury data
T10Y3M.notes: Multiply percentage points by 100 to display basis points. Published dates may differ from DGS component series.

MORTGAGE30US.label: 30-year fixed mortgage rate
MORTGAGE30US.source: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey via FRED
MORTGAGE30US.notes: Copyrighted: citation required. Source: Freddie Mac. Weekly national survey, not a real-time loan quote.

CPIAUCNS.label: Consumer price index, all items
CPIAUCNS.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
CPIAUCNS.notes: Not seasonally adjusted. Calculate year-over-year change using the exact same month one year earlier.

CPILFENS.label: Consumer price index, excluding food and energy
CPILFENS.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
CPILFENS.notes: Not seasonally adjusted. Used for core CPI year-over-year change.

CPIAUCSL.label: Consumer price index, all items, seasonally adjusted
CPIAUCSL.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
CPIAUCSL.notes: Seasonally adjusted. Used for month-over-month change; recent historical observations can be revised.

PCEPILFE.label: PCE price index, excluding food and energy
PCEPILFE.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
PCEPILFE.notes: Seasonally adjusted. Used for core PCE year-over-year change.

PCEPI.label: Personal consumption expenditures price index
PCEPI.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
PCEPI.notes: Seasonally adjusted. The Federal Reserve inflation objective refers to headline PCE, not a target for every price index.

PPIFID.label: Producer price index, final demand
PPIFID.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
PPIFID.notes: Not seasonally adjusted. Used for headline final-demand PPI year-over-year change.

PPIACO.label: Producer price index, all commodities
PPIACO.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
PPIACO.notes: Broad commodities index. This is not the final-demand PPI headline.

A191RL1Q225SBEA.label: Real GDP growth
A191RL1Q225SBEA.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
A191RL1Q225SBEA.notes: Already a seasonally adjusted annualized quarterly percentage change; do not annualize a second time. Quarter observation dates identify quarter starts.

M2SL.label: M2 money supply
M2SL.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED

HOUST.label: Housing starts
HOUST.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development via FRED
HOUST.notes: Seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR), not the number of homes begun in one month.

UNRATE.label: Unemployment rate
UNRATE.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED

PAYEMS.label: Total nonfarm payroll employment
PAYEMS.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
PAYEMS.notes: Seasonally adjusted. Monthly jobs added is the difference between exact consecutive calendar months. Levels and changes are revised.

CES0500000003.label: Average hourly earnings, private payrolls
CES0500000003.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
CES0500000003.notes: Seasonally adjusted. A year-over-year measure of average hourly earnings, not a Goldman Sachs wage tracker.

ICSA.label: Initial unemployment insurance claims
ICSA.source: U.S. Employment and Training Administration via FRED
ICSA.notes: Seasonally adjusted; date identifies the week ending.

JTSJOL.label: Job openings, total nonfarm
JTSJOL.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED
JTSJOL.notes: Seasonally adjusted. JOLTS publication normally lags the reference month.

VIXCLS.label: CBOE Volatility Index
VIXCLS.source: Chicago Board Options Exchange, CBOE Volatility Index: VIX via FRED
VIXCLS.notes: Copyrighted: citation required. Source: Chicago Board Options Exchange. Daily close, not a real-time quote.

UMCSENT.label: University of Michigan consumer sentiment
UMCSENT.source: Surveys of Consumers, University of Michigan via FRED
UMCSENT.notes: Copyrighted: citation required. Source: Surveys of Consumers, University of Michigan. FRED supplies this series with a one-month delay.

NFCI.label: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
NFCI.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago via FRED
NFCI.notes: Positive values indicate tighter-than-average conditions; negative values indicate looser-than-average conditions.

DCOILWTICO.label: WTI crude oil spot price
DCOILWTICO.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration via FRED
DCOILWTICO.notes: Cushing, Oklahoma daily spot price; this is not a front-month futures or intraday quote.

BAMLH0A0HYM2.label: ICE BofA U.S. high-yield option-adjusted spread
BAMLH0A0HYM2.source: ICE Data Indices, LLC via FRED
BAMLH0A0HYM2.reason: Disabled: ICE index data has redistribution restrictions. Configure a separately licensed source before publishing observations. HYG ETF share price is not a credit spread.
